reference_policy: Frozen paper inputs are the reference for published experiments. New packet preparation is a documented reconstruction, not an exact replay of the missing historical command.

frozen_normalized_dataset.scope: Six historical modes, including paired; paper analyses select their reported conditions.

matching_fields: original source-context IDs, text, and hidden PIU IDs

reconstructed_recipe.selection_policy: Evenly spaced original chunks and excerpts; input summaries used for eligibility only
reconstructed_recipe.expansion_policy: Preserve task, oracle, and PIU ownership. Attach original source windows and selected same-collection background chunks, excluding background copies of chunks used by PIU evidence.
required_post_expansion_checks: semantic judgment of every required conclusion
reconstructed_recipe.quality_policy: No historical model results or earlier qualification flags qualify newly expanded contexts.

remaining_historical_gaps: Original preparation of verified source-task inputs
validation_scope: Deterministic preparation, restoration, provenance, and rejection behavior are tested locally. Model-based grounding and qualification must run on newly generated candidates before release.
